extraction.Name: Frank H. Twiss
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want the patent in fee to his 160 acre allotment at the time he received it, September 29, 1919; but he was told it would be taxed, and sold for same, if he did not take the patent, so he accepted the patent
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to the Security Savings Bank, of Rapid City, South Dakota, for $500.00; sold in 1923 to Arnold and Wilhelm, of Scenic, South Dakota, for $500.00 and this in trade
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: had gotten behind in taxes, and, in 1921, he mortgaged it to the Security Savings Bank, of Rapid City, South Dakota, for $500.00, and he then paid his taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: works at farm labor for his living; and that this constitutes his only income
extraction.NOTES: Mentally competent; good health; has a wife and four children to support; family have pretty fair health; mortgage was redeemed at maturity, six months length of time; considers he received an exceedingly poor price for his land; did not sell his allotment for any debts incurred prior to receipt of fee patent; has never received any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; sworn March 8, 1929
